purpose: 空间序列分析图 — 5个空间节点收放节奏
prompt: Architectural spatial sequence analysis diagram showing 5 spatial nodes in axonometric exploded view. From left to right: 1) 入口 Entry (open, expansive, glass canopy), 2) 咨询接待 Reception (semi-enclosed, timber lattice screen), 3) 文化展示 Exhibition (immersive, dimmer, focused lighting), 4) 游客休憩 Rest Area (intimate, warm, garden view), 5) 离园 Exit (open again, water view). Each node shown as a simplified architectural volume with different spatial quality. Connected by a flowing path. Timber-warm #8B6B4A structural elements, whitewash #F2EDE4 walls, warm-amber #D4A853 light indicators showing atmosphere changes. Compression and expansion rhythm visible through volume sizes. Clean architectural diagram, Song typeface labels, tile-grey #4A4A48 outlines. No photorealistic rendering, no decorative clutter.
negative_prompt: Single repeated space, no rhythm variation, photorealistic render, dark background, cluttered, no labels, no spatial hierarchy
